meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会接入 GitHub,在 PR 和 issue 的评论线程里参与对话:被 @ 提及时回复,之后该线程的后续评论也会继续跟进。
howto.when: 当你为仓库配好机器人账号和 webhook 并完成接线后,有人在 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 机器人用户名时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 GitHub 频道,仓库是 github:acme/backend
say.note: 为该仓库建一个消息分组

say.text: 这个仓库是私有的,用 public 那套发送者策略
say.note: 私有仓库只允许协作者评论

say.text: 把 @alice 加进能触发机器人的成员名单
say.note: strict 模式下需要逐个添加成员

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude joins GitHub and takes part in pull request and issue comment threads: it replies when @-mentioned, then follows the thread's later comments.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo is wired to Claude and someone @-mentions the bot username in a pull request or issue comment.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel for repo github:acme/backend
say_en.note: Creates a messaging group for that repo

say_en.text: This repo is private, use the public sender policy
Add @alice as a member who can trigger the agent
